correctness.rationale: The cited Proposition 4.8 gives the universal normalized differential system. Direct derivation shows the derivative zero set is exactly P2(F4), all 21 points, and all other points over an algebraic closure are nonsingular. Ten-coefficient exact enumeration by two independent field-arithmetic implementations gives 960 smooth curves; complete GL3(F4) orbit computation gives 960 and 189 stabilizers, while independent four-generator orbit BFS also gives 960. Multiplicity of scalar representatives (three) accounts for projective stabilizer 63. An explicit diagonal representative is checked directly at all rational point patterns.

originality.rationale: The primary arXiv:2207.11981 establishes a derivative normal form and exhibits an individual F4 example, but no exact rational moduli count or unique PGL3(F4) orbit. The prior Singer-automorphism theorem is conditional on possessing Singer symmetry, which is not proved for arbitrary Frobenius-nonclassical sextics there. Independent searches of the indexed mathematical record and the recoverable prior algebraic-geometry claims found no covering result; older unindexed literature remains a risk.

value.rationale: An extremal q+2 degree case singled out by the structural theorem is classified completely at the first nonprime characteristic-two field q=4, rather than merely shown to exist. The exact arithmetic orbit and stabilizer give a natural small-field moduli classification useful for characterizing arithmetic forms of the Singer/Pellikaan geometry; it does not rely on an arbitrary parameter slice or a tiny numerical improvement.
